description: This file defines the LogNormal class with methods for calculating lognormal distribution functions, including cumulative distribution, probability density, and inverse functions, within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: LogNormal
classes.description: Provides methods for calculating lognormal distribution functions such as cumulative distribution, probability density, and inverse distribution.

methods.name: cumulative
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative lognormal distribution for a given value, mean, and standard deviation.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the lognormal distribution (PDF or CDF) for a given value, mean, standard deviation, and distribution type.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the lognormal cumulative distribution for a given probability, mean, and standard deviation.
